shots.motion: <Picture 1> the woman with the black bob haircut and mustard-yellow sweater types on the little laptop and smiles, then turns her head to look at the two robots. the pale-blue boxy clay robot in a white lab coat and round glasses nods and waves a hand; the coral-pink clay robot with a red beret bounces happily and waves too.

<Picture 1> the pale-blue boxy clay robot in a white lab coat and round glasses pushes up its glasses and taps buttons on its calculator; the coral-pink clay robot with a red beret tips its beret and twirls its paintbrush. Both robots bounce slightly in place.

<Picture 1> the coral-pink clay robot with a red beret paints quickly on the easel with bold strokes, colorful little cards slide out and fan across the table, confetti flutters down. the woman with the black bob haircut and mustard-yellow sweater claps her hands and laughs.

<Picture 1> the coral-pink clay robot with a red beret scribbles on the paper with its pencil, then more and more paper speech bubbles and curling paper scrolls burst out of the top of its head one after another, piling up and spilling over the desk. The robot wobbles its head. the woman with the black bob haircut and mustard-yellow sweater shakes her head with her arms crossed.

<Picture 1> The giant cardboard control machine comes alive: dials spin, gauges needles swing, buttons blink, levers move up and down and wires wiggle. the woman with the black bob haircut and mustard-yellow sweater scratches her head in confusion. the coral-pink clay robot with a red beret proudly gestures at the machine.

<Picture 1> the pale-blue boxy clay robot in a white lab coat and round glasses very carefully paints a stiff straight grey line on the canvas with a rigid arm. the coral-pink clay robot with a red beret laughs smugly and lifts its colorful painting higher to show it off.
